skill.name: gsap
skill.description: Reference guide for writing deterministic GSAP animations in HyperFrames, including tweens, timelines, easing, responsive motion, typewriter text, and audio visualizers.
skill.summary: Create deterministic GSAP tweens, timelines, typewriter effects, and audio visualizers for HyperFrames.
skill.author: heygen-com

security_audit.summary: The audit found no prompt injection, secret access, or data exfiltration intent in the reviewed files. Most static alerts are false positives from Markdown code formatting and animation terms. The CDN examples and audio extraction helper introduce real network, external-command, and file-write risks that should be documented with user confirmation.

remediation.issue: CDN script examples load third-party JavaScript.
remediation.suggestion: Offer a local or package-based GSAP option, and add integrity attributes if CDN snippets remain.

remediation.issue: The audio helper executes ffmpeg locally.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user approval before running the helper, and document that ffmpeg processes the selected media file.

remediation.issue: The audio helper writes to a user-selected output path.
remediation.suggestion: Refuse to overwrite existing files unless a force option is provided, and document the output location.

content.value_statement: Creating deterministic GSAP motion for HyperFrames requires precise timing and cleanup. This skill gives focused references for tweens, timelines, typewriter effects, and audio visualization.
actual_capabilities: Explains gsap.to(), gsap.from(), gsap.fromTo(), and gsap.set() usage.
Covers easing, stagger values, repeats, yoyo behavior, callbacks, and overwrite options.
Documents timelines, labels, nesting, position parameters, and playback control.
Provides typewriter text patterns using TextPlugin, cursors, backspacing, and word rotation.
Includes audio visualizer guidance with an ffmpeg-based extraction helper.
Highlights performance practices for transforms, opacity, will-change, and gsap.quickTo().
limitations: It is a reference skill, not a full GSAP API manual.
The audio helper requires local ffmpeg, Python 3.9 or later, and numpy.
CDN examples depend on external script availability unless rewritten for local assets.
It does not inspect or test generated animation output.

use_cases.title: Create HyperFrames Motion
use_cases.description: Build deterministic entrance, exit, and sequence animations with GSAP tweens and timelines.

use_cases.title: Prototype Text Reveals
use_cases.description: Design typewriter effects with cursor states, backspacing, word rotation, and clear timing.

use_cases.title: Prepare Audio Visuals
use_cases.description: Extract audio frame data and map loudness or frequency bands to canvas, DOM, or Three.js motion.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Tween
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the gsap skill to animate a HyperFrames element from opacity zero to visible, using transform properties and cleanup guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Timeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the gsap skill to create a timeline with labels, defaults, overlapping motion, and playback control for three scene elements.

prompt_templates.title: Add a Typewriter Effect
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the gsap skill and references/effects.md to create a deterministic typewriter sequence with a blinking cursor and backspacing.

prompt_templates.title: Design an Audio Visualizer
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the gsap skill and audio visualizer reference to plan data extraction, timeline registration, smoothing, and render mapping.

output_examples.input: Animate a product card reveal in HyperFrames.
output: A timeline plan with shared defaults, transform-based entrance motion, and staggered child reveals.
Performance notes that avoid layout animation and include cleanup guidance.
A deterministic sequence for typing, holding, backspacing, and switching words.
Cursor state guidance for blinking, solid, and hidden phases.
A workflow for extracting frame-level audio data before render time.
Mapping guidance for bass, treble, RMS, smoothing, and visual layer depth.

best_practices: Prefer transforms and opacity instead of layout properties when the visual result allows it.
Use timelines, labels, and position parameters for readable sequencing.
Kill or pause animations when elements leave the scene.
anti_patterns: Do not create tweens before target DOM elements exist.
Do not mix svgOrigin and transformOrigin on the same SVG element.
Do not rely on async data loading for HyperFrames timeline construction.

faq.question: What is this skill for?
faq.answer: It helps write GSAP animations for HyperFrames compositions with deterministic timelines and performance guidance.

faq.question: Does it install GSAP?
faq.answer: No. It provides reference material and examples. Users must manage project dependencies separately.

faq.question: Can it create typewriter effects?
faq.answer: Yes. The references include cursor states, backspacing, word rotation, and multi-line cursor handoff patterns.

faq.question: Can it process audio?
faq.answer: It includes a local helper script that extracts frame-level audio data for visualizer animations.

faq.question: Is external network access required?
faq.answer: The typewriter reference shows CDN script tags. Projects can use local bundled GSAP assets instead.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: It is marked as compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
